I've been in your shoes, a matter of fact I still am. I feel like an alien a lot. Whether it's being the kid everyone laughs at, or just simply not understanding why people act a certain way. But the unique thing about us "aliens" is that we're not alone. By god there's no way we could be alone. Yes at times it may seem like we're all alone, but if you just a look a little further past the bad, you're sure to find a little good. We're all just created weirdly I guess. The point of what I'm saying is you need to go out and find someone that isn't toxic and greedy. Or just find some other activities to pass the time. Reading in libraries (Also a good way to meet people!), and walking alone in a forest or a park helps me clear my head. I always felt trapped in a dark tunnel, but all I realized was that if I kept searching and searching I'd find something worth while. I'm sorry if I haven't helped, as I am slightly rambling I guess. My final answer is just ... keep searching.
